svg.text: Putting a machine in the loop
Harness engineering to support academic research
Not human in the loop. The human designs the loop, and the machine works inside it.

g.text: The harness (the human): you build and maintain it
what counts as good in the field
skills and files from your Drive
What evaluation finds feeds back into the harness
read at the start of each session
The engineered harness lives in Drive: skills, transcripts, summaries, context, and the other files the tools read and write.
Different users and different activities want different harnesses.
Most of the harness is work librarians already know: choosing sources, setting search rules, and judging results.

Clark, E., Ross, A. S., Tan, C., Ji, Y., & Smith, N. A. (2018). Creative writing with a machine in the loop: Case studies on slogans and stories. Proceedings of the Conference on Intelligent User Interfaces, 329–340. https://doi.org/10.1145/3172944.3172983

Natarajan, S., Mathur, S., Sidheekh, S., Stammer, W., & Kersting, K. (2025). Human-in-the-loop or AI-in-the-loop? Automate or collaborate? Proceedings of the AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence, 39(27), 28594–28600. https://doi.org/10.1609/aaai.v39i27.35083
